summary:
Many people in their twenties reach a point where life feels strangely empty even when nothing is obviously wrong. This is common, and it is not a sign that something is broken. Our new article explains the quarter-life search for meaning, how it can differ from depression, and the small, values-based steps that may help.

It is written for anyone feeling adrift and unsure where to start.

Equal Psychology provides psychology and psychological therapy for adults and young adults in Kew, Croydon, and online across Melbourne.

Medicare rebates available with a GP referral.

Read it here: https://www.equalpsychology.com.au/post/searching-for-meaning-in-your-twenties
